title: flatMap flattens that one level, which is exactly one level too many
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

given.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
payload flatMap ((order) -> (order.line_items default []) map ((li) -> { orderId: order.order_id, sku: li.sku }))

solution:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
payload flatMap ((order) -> (order.line_items default []) map ((li) -> { orderId: order.order_id, sku: li.sku }))

explanation.approach: Same shape of function, but flattened into one list of rows, `orderId` repeated on each one — this is the sibling-rows shape the CSV writer needs.
